own_solution.law: Escape speed v = sqrt(2GM/R) = R sqrt(8 pi G rho / 3), scaled from Earth: v = v_E (R/R_E) sqrt(rho/rho_E)

notes: Scaling: 3390/6371 = 0.53210; sqrt(3.93/5.51) = sqrt(0.71325) = 0.84454; v = 11.19 x 0.44938 = 5.0285 km/s. Direct with G = 6.674e-11 gives 5.025 km/s and Earth 11.18 km/s; the stated 11.19 km/s is consistent with the stated Earth data within their 3-4 significant figures, so no contradiction. With a 310 km same-density layer on the planet R = 3700 km and v = 5.0285 x 3700/3390 = 5.488 km/s (direct: 5.485). The moon's pull is ignored per the problem, so moon sentences are D; probe mass cancels from the energy balance.
